prompt: Cinematic wide shot of an elderly man standing in the middle of a dark, rain-slicked city street at night, walking away from the camera. The lighting is dramatic, with cold rain falling through the warm, hazy glow of street lamps, creating a moody and hopeful final aesthetic.
